info.description: REST API for the BAP Pulse badminton club app — Bad A Paname.
info.title: BAP Pulse API

post.description: Creates a Firebase user and their profile. Returns a temporary password to share with the new user.

parameters.description: User first name, last name and email
parameters.name: body

post.description: Fetches the full club roster (scoped by the club token) and upserts it locally. Pending users whose licence now appears are auto-approved.
post.summary: Sync the club roster from the FFBAD API

post.description: Flips the user to approved. Optionally corrects gender/FFBAD rank (FFBAD data may be stale or missing). If the user hasn't played a match yet, the starting ELO is recomputed from the corrected rank/gender.

parameters.description: Firebase UID of the target user
parameters.name: uid

parameters.description: Firebase UID of the target user
parameters.name: uid

post.description: Updates the user's role in the database. Takes effect immediately on the next request (no token refresh needed).

parameters.description: Firebase UID of the target user
parameters.name: uid

post.description: Called after a successful Firebase login. On first login it creates the profile: if the FFBAD licence matches the club roster the account is auto-approved and prefilled (name/gender/rank/ELO from FFBAD), otherwise it is left pending for admin validation. Returns the existing profile on subsequent calls.

get.description: Returns both received and sent challenges, most recent first.
get.summary: List challenges involving the authenticated user

post.description: v1 only supports SINGLES (one challenger, one challenged). The recipient receives a push notification and can accept/decline.
Creates a PENDING match. ELO and performance points are NOT yet applied — they will be on confirmation by the opposing team. The opposing team is notified.
post.summary: Submit a match score for confirmation

post.description: Admin-only. Records an official match between any members — the caller does NOT need to be a player. The match is created CONFIRMED: ELO and performance points are applied immediately, the match-confirmed news is emitted, and NO awaiting-confirmation notification is sent. Players submitting via the app keep using POST /matches (opponent confirmation flow).
post.summary: Record a match as an admin (auto-confirmed)

post.description: Applies ELO + performance points and emits the match-confirmed news. Caller must be a member of the team opposite to the submitter.
Marks the match CONTESTED. ELO is not applied. The submitter is notified.

get.description: Returns the full membership, each enriched with monthly performance (score, rank, 7-day gain), monthly W/L/M and currently held jerseys. Same aggregation window/tableau as the /rankings/* family.
get.summary: Members roster with monthly stats and jerseys

get.description: Latest first. Anyone authenticated can read.

post.description: Admin only. The created news has source = "MANUAL".

put.description: Admin only. Updates emoji, title and body. Source and references are immutable.

get.description: Paginated, most recent first. Includes both read and unread.
get.summary: List notifications for the authenticated user

post.summary: Mark all the caller's notifications as read

get.summary: Count unread notifications for the authenticated user

get.description: Wins against an opponent whose ELO at match time exceeded the player's by at least UpsetThreshold.
Sum of performance points awarded during the period for the tableau.

post.description: Upserts the token, binding it to the authenticated user. Called by the mobile app at login and on FCM token refresh.

delete.description: Called by the mobile app on logout. Only deletes the token if it belongs to the authenticated user.

put.description: Users can only update their own profile. Admins can update any profile.

delete.description: Users can only delete their own account. Admins can delete any account.

get.description: Returns the user's SINGLES matches sorted DESC by played_at, reshaped from the user's perspective (sets as mine vs opp, signed ELO delta).

Singles-only for the MVP. Returns ELO, monthly perf score + rank, 7-day perf gain, monthly stats (matches/wins/losses/upsets/streak), held jerseys, yellow-jersey threshold, daily perf-history sparkline, and head-to-head (nemesis + favorite victim).
get.summary: Aggregated profile payload for the mobile profile screen

match_type.description: optional; defaults to SINGLES (v1 only accepts SINGLES)

license_number.description: FFBAD licence; matched against the club roster
